purpose: Replace neutral spatial fields in the Afghanistan empirical adapter with deterministic pre-benchmark geography and 2004 settlement structure already present in the source package.

transforms.rank_rule: average-rank percentile across the frozen 401 districts; no fitted coefficient
transforms.urbanization: equal mean of settlement_intensity and percentile(settlement_concentration_hhi)
transforms.infrastructure: equal mean of settlement_intensity and frozen graph-connectivity percentile
transforms.observability: equal mean of settlement_intensity, settlement-concentration percentile, and graph-connectivity percentile
transforms.terrain_friction: remain 1.0 because no independent terrain/elevation source is yet part of the frozen case package
transforms.administrative_capacity: remain 0.5 because settlement density is not administrative state capacity

forbidden: no UCDP 2004-2021 outcome enters a transform
no Afghan War Diary row enters a transform
no coefficient selected from predictive score
no outcome-derived road or observability proxy
acceptance: each derived field has nonzero cross-district variation
permuting district outcome labels cannot change any derived field
case construction remains deterministic and source-hash bound
